derived_inputs.advertising_rule_count: Number of rows in consumer_protections.advertising; null when the list is absent.
derived_inputs.advertising_substantive_count: Rows in consumer_protections.advertising whose rule_type is not responsible_gambling_message_required.
derived_inputs.legal_age_min: Minimum age across the legal_age rows; null when none are entered.
derived_inputs.market_live: True when any legal_status row has market_segment regulated_sportsbook and status live.
derived_inputs.pg_funding_mechanism: funding_mechanism of the pg_funding.yaml record with the latest fiscal_year; null when the file is absent.
derived_inputs.prevalence_searched: True when a prevalence study is on file, or when the latest dated search record for the state in prevalence_studies.yaml found none; null when no search has been recorded, or when a search found a study that is not yet entered.
derived_inputs.prevalence_years_since_latest: Rubric effective year minus the latest fieldwork_year among the state's prevalence studies; null when none.
derived_inputs.self_exclusion_program_type: consumer_protections.self_exclusion.program_type; null when the section is absent.
